section: Advent of Europeans in Andhra - Portuguese, Dutch, French and English
subsections: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: The Second Carnatic War was fought during which period?
accepted.x: The Second Carnatic War took place from 1749 to 1754. During this conflict, the British installed Muhammad Ali as the Nawab of the Carnatic.
accepted.tq: Use the chronological range directly and distinguish the war from the later battles of Chandurthi and Wandiwash.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bussy obtained the Circars for the French through a grant from Salabat Jung.
2. The grant of the Circars to the French took place in 1753.
3. The grant was made by Muhammad Ali, the Nawab of the Carnatic.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Bussy secured the Circars for the French through Salabat Jung’s grant in 1753. Statement 3 is false because Muhammad Ali was not the grantor.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct authority behind the grant and reject the swapped-ruler trap.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the political alignment during the Bobbili War of 1757?
o: Muhammad Ali backed Vizianagaram against the British
Salabat Jung backed Bobbili against the French
The British backed Bobbili against Vizianagaram
accepted.x: In the Bobbili War of 1757, the French supported Vizianagaram. The other alternatives incorrectly change the parties or their alliances.
accepted.tq: Use the alliance-based trap by matching the correct power with its supported side.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s:
With reference to the Battle of Chandurthi, consider the following statements:
1. It was fought in 1758.
2. Colonel Forde was sent from Bengal to lead the British forces.
3. The French forces were commanded by Conflans.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Battle of Chandurthi was fought in 1758; Colonel Forde came from Bengal and defeated the French forces under Conflans.
accepted.tq: Combine date, commander and origin of the force before selecting the complete code.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: Who defeated the French under Conflans in the Battle of Chandurthi?
accepted.x: Colonel Forde, who was sent from Bengal, defeated the French forces commanded by Conflans at Chandurthi in 1758.
accepted.tq: Apply the commander–battle association and avoid confusing Forde with Bussy or Conflans.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Battle of Chandurthi
B. Grant of the Circars to the French
C. Bobbili War
D. Fall of Masulipatnam
accepted.x: The correct order is the grant of the Circars to the French in 1753, the Bobbili War in 1757, the Battle of Chandurthi in 1758, and the fall of Masulipatnam in 1759.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the 1757 and 1758 events between them.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT included among the territories given by Salabat Jung to the British after the fall of Masulipatnam?
accepted.x: Machilipatnam, Nizampatnam, Vakal Mannar and part of Kondapalli were given to the British by Salabat Jung in 1759. Pondicherry was not included in this grant.
accepted.tq: Find the outsider in the territorial list rather than relying only on the event year.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: The fall of Masulipatnam in 1759 resulted in which of the following developments?
o: The Dutch acquired Madras as their principal base
The Portuguese regained control over the Andhra coast
The British received Machilipatnam and certain adjoining territories from Salabat Jung
The French obtained the Northern Circars from Salabat Jung
accepted.x: After the fall of Masulipatnam in 1759, Salabat Jung gave Machilipatnam, Nizampatnam, Vakal Mannar and part of Kondapalli to the British.
accepted.tq: Link the military event to its immediate territorial consequence and reject reversed-control options.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: Which event is associated with the effective end of French power in India?
o: Grant of the Circars to the French
accepted.x: The Battle of Wandiwash in 1760 marked the end of French power in India.
accepted.tq: Match the decisive battle with its historical consequence.
accepted.sec: Anglo-French rivalry in Andhra - Carnatic Wars, Battle of Chandurthi

accepted.s: Which European power was the first to receive the right to mint coins in India according to the given European-trading chronology?
accepted.x: The Dutch were the first among the European trading powers listed to receive the right to mint coins.
accepted.tq: Test the distinctive privilege associated with one European power rather than its factory location.

accepted.s: Which of the following is identified as the last European power to establish a factory in Andhra in the stated chronology?
accepted.x: The Portuguese are identified as the last of the four European powers to establish a factory in Andhra, in 1670.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the last entrant from the earlier factory-establishment claims and use the associated year.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the commercial practices of European trading companies in Andhra:
1. The Dutch, Portuguese and French advanced money to weavers.
2. The Dutch, Portuguese and French generally paid weavers fairly.
3. The English paid less and demanded high quality, leading weavers to avoid them.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Dutch, Portuguese and French advanced money and paid fairly, whereas the English paid less while demanding high-quality goods, causing weavers to avoid them.
accepted.tq: Compare all four companies across the same commercial practices before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: Why did Machilipatnam attract the Portuguese, Dutch, French and English?
o: It was the headquarters of the French East India Company
It was the first capital of the British Presidency
It was associated with chintz and diamond trade
It controlled the only land route to Delhi
accepted.x: Machilipatnam attracted all four European powers because of its important chintz and diamond trade.
accepted.tq: Connect the commercial attraction of a port with the commodities that drew competing powers.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the English position in Andhra is correct?
o: The English controlled Andhra before establishing any base at Madras.
Madras was established by the French in 1753 to control the Circars.
Madras, established as an English base in 1639, later enabled English control over Andhra.
Machilipatnam became the English base only after the Battle of Wandiwash in 1760.
accepted.x: Madras became an English base in 1639 and subsequently helped the English extend their control over Andhra. The other statements reverse the chronology or attribute Madras to the wrong power.
accepted.tq: Use the base–date–later expansion relationship and reject reversed chronology.
